questions.question: If 8 α 48, 12 α 120 and 15 α 195, then what is the value of 'A' in 19 α A?

Hence, ‘323’ is the correct answer.

**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error,select 'No Error'.**

Our professor taught us that (1)/ one should respect the (2)/ religions of others as much as his own. (3)/ No Error (4)

__
 
• The error lies in the **incorrect usage of the pronoun 'his'.**
 
• The** possessive pronoun 'his' **needs to be replaced with **possessive pronoun 'one's'.**
 
• The word** ‘one’ ** act as an **indefinite pronoun or impersonal pronoun** in the English language.
 
• ​ It is a **gender-neutral, third-person singular pronoun.** 
 
• When** 'One'** is used as the subject then its **objective case** i.e.** 'one'**, **possessive case** i.e.** 'one's'**, and its **reflexive case** i.e.** 'oneself' **will be used.
 
• **No other **objective, possessive or reflexive case will be used with** 'one'.**

**Thus, the correct sentence is**:* Our professor taught us that one should respect the religions of others as much as **one's** own. *
